message.content:
This document is a technical README and set of engineering notes for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash). Key technical points:

**Architecture & memory tiers**
- Engine splits model across VRAM expert cache, pinned RAM tier, and NVMe SSD; experts streamed on demand. More VRAM/RAM = faster; NVMe SSD required.
- Supports 1–16 GPUs with layer splitting, tensor parallel, MTP/DFlash
